creator: _delta_pin
new_resources.owner: bioetl.infrastructure.storage.target_classification_migration_pins owns DeltaTable pin reads for RF-011 migration profile checks
new_resources.closer: DeltaTable finishes the native table operation before return; no table handle is stored on a process-global owner.
new_resources.shutdown_contract: Synchronous DeltaTable construction and metadata/version reads release the native handle before _delta_pin returns; failures before allocation have no close obligation.
new_resources.production_entrypoint: opt-in IUPHAR target classification migration prepare/promote/rollback

cancellation.applicability: owning async boundary; these primitives are synchronous
cancellation.expected: Propagate cancellation after the documented cleanup; do not infer a stopped native call from a cancelled await.
cancellation.observation: Cancel the owner around the call and observe remaining handles.

error.applicability: applicable after successful acquisition; no close obligation for a handle never created
error.expected: Preserve the original failure and release any handle this function already acquired.
error.observation: Inject after allocation and during close; inspect retained handles.

normal.expected: The owning function acquires this local file, table, lock, or directory iterator and releases it before return.
normal.observation: At acquisition and owning return: resource identity, open/close events, and handles remaining.

retry.applicability: outer caller attempt; the primitive has no internal retry
retry.expected: A failed attempt must not leave the previous handle open before the next attempt.
retry.observation: Compare opened and closed identities per attempt.

timeout.applicability: no intrinsic timeout on the synchronous primitive
timeout.expected: Apply only an outer deadline; timeout is not itself a close receipt.
timeout.observation: Observe the outer deadline and whether the call returned.
